q: You want to message your agent from WhatsApp. Which layer does connecting WhatsApp touch?
explanation: Messaging is an interface — it is how you reach the agent. Whatsapp/Telegram sit at the interface layer.

q: Saving a reusable skill belongs to which layer?
explanation: Skills are a capability of the agent — part of the capabilities layer alongside tools, memory, and context files.

q: What drives the 'self-improving loop' in Hermes?
options: Paying more per month automatically improves it
You use it, it records context, it saves skills, and it gets better next session
It downloads a new model every hour
It only improves when you manually edit code
explanation: The loop is: use the agent, it records context, it saves reusable skills, and it recalls them next session — that's how it improves at your work.

q: If a colleague asks 'which layer runs the brain?', the best answer is:
options: The agent core — model, tools, memory and skills
explanation: The agent core is the brain: the model, the tools it can call, persistent memory, and the skills it has learned.
